speaker: Grace - Host
text: Release is scheduled for Thursday. Where do we stand on testing?

speaker: Omar - QA
text: Not good. We still have a backlog of about fifteen test cases that haven't been run yet.

speaker: Ines - Engineer
text: Fifteen? I thought QA was almost done last week.

speaker: Omar - QA
text: New features kept coming in faster than we could test them. The QA backlog just kept growing.

speaker: Grace - Host
text: So realistically, can we still hit Thursday?

speaker: Omar - QA
text: Honestly, no. At this pace we'll miss the deadline unless we either delay the release or freeze new features immediately.

speaker: Ines - Engineer
text: I think we should freeze feature work now and let QA catch up, better than shipping something broken.

speaker: Grace - Host
text: Agreed. Let's freeze new merges as of today so the testing delay doesn't push the launch even further out.

speaker: Omar - QA
text: That helps. If we freeze now, I think we can clear the backlog by Wednesday and still make Thursday, just barely.
